title: The redirect-following landing audit — GAP-004's recorded residual
environment: local (the fixture matrix; no live plane)
doctrine: The honest-evidence law: nothing is auto-followed, masked or assumed — every redirect hop is fetched manually (redirect: "manual") and recorded with its status + Location; the 307 platform bridge is DISCLOSED in the evidence, never hidden behind an auto-follow; no live-plane claim is made from local fixtures.

notRun.reason: the wave-level redeploy + journey MEASURE re-run is the Lead's
notRun.owner: the Lead's wave-F redeploy + journey re-run

notes: STAGE SPLIT (honest): this record is the F-a-4a STAGE-1 SKELETON — the implementation (the chain follower, the landed-surface audit, the landing-chain finding, the fixture matrix) is committed, but verifiedLocally is EMPTY by design: stage 2 owns the verification battery (typecheck, the exact lint baseline, the unit suite, harness-e2e on the PG rail, governance:check, deploy:validate) with the exact numbers, plus this record's finalization and the PUBLIC-DEPLOYMENT.md append.

DESIGN — the 3-hop budget (MAX_LANDING_REDIRECT_HOPS = 3, the named constant): one fetch per iteration, the start URL itself counted; a chain is followable only if it terminates within 3 same-origin fetches (307->HTML = 2 fetches, 307->307->HTML = 3, one redirect more = budget-exceeded).

DESIGN — same-origin only: each hop's Location is resolved against the current URL and its origin compared with the harness's ctx.targetUrl origin; a cross-origin hop STOPS the chain (kind "cross-origin", the honest not-run — cross-origin following is out of audit scope, owner the Lead) and is NEVER fetched.

DESIGN — the landing-chain finding class (severity major, defectClass "landing-chain", added to the closed defect-class vocabulary 14 -> 15 with the contract test's count pin moved): a redirect LOOP, an over-budget chain or an unreachable hop means a real browser fails to land too — a FINDING plus a fail step, never a silent not-run.

DESIGN — the honest terminal shapes: an HTML terminal gets the EXACT existing discover-landing treatment (the full dimension audit + titleOf, over the chain's own terminal fetch — auditSurface was split into fetch + auditFetchedSurface so no second landing request is made, and the direct HTML landing path stays byte-equivalent through the shared recordHtmlLanding); a non-HTML terminal keeps today's honest not-run extended with the chain facts; the cross-origin hop records the honest not-run with the Lead owner.

DESIGN — the "unreachable" chain kind: the work order's three terminal shapes do not enumerate a mid-chain transport failure; the follower records it honestly (the landing-chain finding with the transport error in the observed) rather than misclassifying it as a served non-HTML terminal.

DESIGN — the evidence disclosure: StepEvidence gained an optional "location" field, set only when an answer carries a Location header (non-redirect answers stay byte-identical to HEAD); every hop's status + raw Location is disclosed in the step's observed string and the finding's evidence string.

THE FIXTURE MATRIX (tests/integration/journey/landing-audit.test.ts): six scenarios on a local random-port fixture server — /direct (200 HTML), /one-hop (307 -> /direct), /two-hops (307 -> 307 -> /direct), /loop-a <-> /loop-b (the cycle), /over-budget (the 5-redirect chain ob1..ob4 -> /direct), /cross-origin (307 -> http://external.example.invalid/landing) — driving followLandingChain DIRECTLY (DB-free, no journey run); the LIVE re-run is the Lead's MEASURE step at the wave's redeploy.

DISPATCH HISTORY: F-a died at its turn ceiling at 0% (no artifacts); F-a-2 died in a tool-session outage at 0% (no artifacts); F-a-3 died at its turn ceiling at 0% (no artifacts — the F-survey-2 ground truth confirmed the same clean base each time); F-a-4a is THIS stage-1 implementation (code + fixture matrix + this skeleton, one local commit; the battery + push + PR are the later stages').
